## Dear Requester

Thank you for your Freedom of Information request, received by the Council on 10 April 2026, reference FOI002930.

Please accept our sincere apologies for the delay in our response.

You requested the following information:

## Your Request

I am writing to seek data in order to provide context to some upcoming work:

Q1) Please advise, based on your business rates database, how many tattoo-specific premises or tattoo studios were known to you for each financial year for the past 10 years.

Q2a) Please can you advise, based on your Environmental Health records, how many premises were registered with you in order to provide tattooing services or were tattoo studios, during each financial year for the past 10 years under the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1982 (LGMPA 1982).

Please note that tattooing is considered alongside acupuncture, electrolysis, semi-permanent skin colouring, and piercing to be referred to more broadly as a 'special treatment', which is regulated by the above Act.

Q2b) Please can you advise, based on your Environmental Health records regarding the above premises, how many individual practitioners were registered with you in order to provide tattooing services or were working within tattoo studios, during each financial year for the past 10 years under the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1982 (LGMPA 1982)?

## Our Response

The Council confirms that it holds some information relevant to your request, and our response is set out below:

Q1)

Our database shows 4 accounts that include 'tattoo' as part of their business name. We don't keep a record of the types of businesses that are trading, so there may be other trading. However, below is a list for the last 10 years.

This concludes our response to your request.

We do our best to provide the information you require. If you feel we have misunderstood your request, we invite you to offer further clarification. If you expand your request this will be dealt with as a new enquiry.

If you are dissatisfied with the handling of your request and would like to request an internal review, please contact us within 40 working days of the date of this letter using the following contact details: Information Governance Team, Royal Borough of Windsor & Maidenhead, Town Hall, St Ives Road, Maidenhead SL6 1RF or send an email to foi@rbwm.gov.uk

Public authorities are not obliged to accept a review after this date.

If you remain dissatisfied with the handling of your request or complaint following an internal review, you have the right to appeal to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO): The Information Commissioner's Office, Wycliffe House, Water Lane, Wilmslow, Cheshire, SK9 5AF, Telephone: 0303 123 1113, email casework@ico.org.uk, website: http://www.ico.org.uk/complaints/handling/complain

There is no charge for making an appeal.

Yours faithfully,

Information Governance Team
